proof_methods.TDD: Each live-discovered defect was reproduced by a failing regression test before its fix.
proof_methods.EDD: The receipt binds source, immutable image, aggregate IDs, fencing tokens, participant probes and cleanup counts.
proof_methods.CDD: Queue ownership, persisted cluster targeting, session state and cleanup contracts were checked.
proof_methods.BDD: Given an owned provision or reclaim job, when its lifecycle-worker is deleted, then another process fences the old owner and completes the same aggregate on Arena.
proof_methods.CBT: Readiness, queue, model reachability, Showroom validation, reclaim idempotency and residue scans were exercised independently.
proof_methods.red_green: RED defects were retained as regressions; GREEN is successful provision and reclaim takeover with higher fencing tokens and zero cleanup residue.
